what: the lane's stage-34 slot-expression IR export, read as a CROSS-CHECK of this gate's hand port (ruling I-8).  Eight structural comparisons per slot at every shape a bundle exists for.  Nothing here is evaluated and nothing here is consumed by the terminal identity: a disagreement is a question about which side is wrong, answered by reading the Rust arm
what_this_is_not: not a check of the prover, not a privacy statement, and not a replacement for the hand port.  The export carries no challenge value, so agreement here says the two agree about the SHAPE of every slot polynomial and says nothing about any number the gate computes
